benchmark.definition: equal-weight daily-rebalanced mean of the cached universe's pct_chg close-to-close returns over the same window; stale observations are excluded from that session

benchmark_definition: equal-weight daily-rebalanced mean of the cached universe's pct_chg close-to-close returns over the same window; stale observations are excluded from that session
disclaimer: paper tracking only; style-tilt demo, not validated alpha
return_basis: pct_chg/100 (Baostock ex-rights preclose); raw price = amount/volume (CNY VWAP proxy, volume > 0) is used only for volume x price cost conversion and the stale liquidation reference
stale_policy: a session is stale when the raw price amount/volume, pct_chg or volume is missing/invalid or the volume is zero; hold at the last valid raw price (return 0, flagged stale); when the price returns the resume-day pct_chg carries the gap return; after max_stale_sessions consecutive stale sessions, liquidate at the last valid raw price with no extra trade cost (no tradable price exists) and hold the proceeds as cash
tradable_gate: execution buys require raw price amount/volume > 0, finite pct_chg, volume > 0 (R9 tradable_mask) and pct_chg <= 9.8% (R19a limit-up approximation); blocked weight stays in cash with a warning; at a rebalance, limit-down blocks the sell and limit-up blocks the buy

turnover.definition: realised one-sided turnover = 0.5 * (buys + sells) / pre-cost portfolio value, per executed rebalance

volatility_basis: rolling(20, min_periods=5).std() of pct_chg/100 through the execution close, masking suspension and resume-day gap returns as data/pipeline.py does; short histories fall back to 2% daily
